title: Bevel testimonials
description: Reviews on white: an arched collage of sixteen photos with 24px corners in eight mirrored columns (short tiles at the sides, long ones in the middle), a big two-line centered title tucked into its foot and a grey paragraph, then a row of pale 32px-rounded review cards with orange stars, a semibold headline, a grey byline and the quote, drifting slowly left. Phones show the four middle columns, cropped at the edges.
